name: Those Blasted Troggs!
summary: Foreman Stonebrow watches troggs wreck Gol'Bolar Quarry and calls for help. They have broken his equipment and powder barrels, and his fading aim keeps him from fighting them himself. He sends willing fighters into the pit to thin the Rockjaw Skullthumpers.

sections.title: Chaos in the Quarry
sections.body: Troggs have overrun the lower terraces of Gol'Bolar Quarry in eastern Dun Morogh. The dwarven excavation once produced well, until the creatures broke through the bedrock and flooded its tunnels. Now they smash the scaffolding and blast apart barrels of powder, leaving the quarry in ruin.

sections.title: Stonebrow's Boiling Rage
sections.body: Foreman Stonebrow watches the ruin from the ridge, furious at what has become of his life's work. Age has weakened his hands and spoiled his aim, so he calls on passing wanderers and Alliance recruits to fight in his place. He wants the burly Rockjaw Skullthumpers thinned, though only their complete destruction would satisfy his anger.

faq.answer: Gol'Bolar Quarry lies in eastern Dun Morogh, south of the main road east toward the gates of Loch Modan. Foreman Stonebrow stands on the rim above the excavation pits.

faq.q: Why are the troggs attacking the quarry?
faq.answer: Troggs dwell deep beneath the earth across Khaz Modan. Dwarven excavations often break into the caverns where they nest, and the troggs surge to the surface and overwhelm active mines.
Foreman Stonebrow supervises Gol'Bolar Quarry. Bitter and hot-tempered, he sends willing fighters to clear out the troggs because his combat skills are fading.
Rockjaw Skullthumpers are brutish frontline enforcers of the trogg tribe in Gol'Bolar Quarry. They use raw strength and primitive clubs to bludgeon intruders.

faq.q: Why can't Stonebrow clear the quarry himself?
faq.answer: Stonebrow says his eyesight and aim have faded since his youth. Because age leaves him at risk of being overwhelmed in the quarry pits, he hires adventurers to fight there.

faq.q: What are the troggs destroying in the quarry?
faq.answer: Troggs are wrecking heavy equipment and disrupting mining at the quarry. They are also detonating supplies, including barrels of dwarven blasting powder.

angles.text: As a dwarf, the troggs' invasion of Khaz Modan strikes close to home. The stonecutters have been driven from Gol'Bolar, making vengeance in the pit personal.
As a miner, you know Gol'Bolar for its stonecutting and mineral extraction. Clearing the invaders is the first step toward getting the picks swinging again.
